subject: Wednesday appointment timing
text: Hi there, Sorry, I'm scrambling a bit. The Wednesday appointment? I might not be free after the school pickup because my nephew has a dentist thing that was supposed to be Tuesday, but the office rescheduled, so now I'll be stuck in the waiting room and then have to drop him at my sister's. I can do Thursday morning maybe, unless Thursday is bad because my mother called about her prescription again and I forgot to ask when the pharmacy closes. Could we push to ten? Or early afternoon? I have the wrong calendar in front of me. Anyway, let me know what works. Sorry again. I hope that isn't too late to mention. It got tangled with groceries, the neighbor's package delivery, and one very long errand that took over an hour. If Tuesday somehow survives, keep it. If not, anything with a little cushion after it would be great. I really do appreciate your patience.
